Site information

Privacy

Effective 19 November 2026

Website analytics

Paint Commons uses Google Analytics to understand website visits and traffic sources. Google Analytics uses cookies and receives technical information such as browser and device details. Search terms, catalogue filter values, selected paint IDs, and correction form contents are not included in the analytics fields we send. Analytics page URLs omit query parameters and fragments; referral URLs retain only their site origin. Valid campaign tags may be used to measure traffic sources.

Google's handling of analytics information is described in its privacy policy. Advertising personalisation and Google signals are disabled in the site tag. You can block analytics through your browser's privacy settings or an analytics blocker; the catalogue remains available.

Catalogue and corrections

Browsing the catalogue does not require an account. The correction form describes which information will be published in a GitHub issue. Do not include private information in a public correction.

Service providers

Cloudflare serves the website and protects the correction form with Turnstile. GitHub hosts the public catalogue and correction issues. These providers may keep technical request records for security and operation of their services.

Contact

For questions about this site, contact hello@stipplewise.com.
